page.overview:
Who is Dalia?

When first enters , he can find and the other three children speaking to each other as a group as the sun sets. asks them if they are in love. then responds that she wants to attend 's class when she grows up and get married. then comments that is unmarried and wonders what that means. Lastly, says that she heard being in love is the sweetest thing in the world, but she does not think she can handle something sweeter than berries.

After this, can find in the empty plot near . She asks what someone from out of town is doing in a place like this. When asks what she is doing, reveals that she is planning on starting a fruit garden in the plot, though she is keeping it from her mother for now. Once the garden is made, she will be able to eat as mush fruit as she wants. However, she has not yet decided what she will plant. Despite this, promises to share some of what she grows with .

After has calmed and started "" , he can find crying in the empty plot. explains that she wanted to plant an orchard in the plot, going so far as to pick up the , pull the weeds, and till the ground. Unfortunately, the from the nearby trough is unusable due to a flow of into it. Without the , her orchard will not be able to flourish. After she is finished speaking, will receive "" .

When returns to , has already cleaned up her and left. gives a that was given to her by "the lady who cleaned it up" as a thank you for caring about her. claims that also gave her some , which has inspired her to make her garden into a patch. She tells he can come eat the anytime he likes, after which "" will be complete.
